findings.title: MSF condemns Israeli drone strike that killed two staff working in Gaza City clinic
findings.location: MSF Gaza City clinic, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: MSF announces a planned suspension of medical activities on November 29 following the November 27 fatal strike. The clinic provides maternal care, family planning, nutrition, wound care and mental health consultations, averaging 1,990 patients per week in 2026. Actual implementation and duration of suspension, number of appointments disrupted, and resumption date are unverified. No new casualty count.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Medical activities will be suspended tomorrow in our Gaza City clinic
findings.source_type: Primary official humanitarian medical provider statement

bounded_discovery_context.method: Direct MSF country page and official statement inspection after bounded targeted searches; compared against 20 authenticated prior heartbeats from November 27 12:44 to November 28 07:44.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Earlier records explicitly left service interruption unverified; the provider now announces a planned suspension. The announcement is dated November 28, so tomorrow refers to November 29; this is not confirmation that suspension has already begun or that all MSF operations are suspended.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Exact publication and planned start times unavailable. Newly discovered in observation window, not proven first published then. No production collector comparison.
